eventDetail.scope: The 2027 5th International Conference on Communication Networks and Machine Learning (CNML 2027) focuses on recent advances in communication networks and machine learning, with an emphasis on intelligent and data-driven networking technologies. The conference covers a wide range of topics, including wireless and mobile communications, network intelligence, network security, edge computing, Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent signal processing, and AI-enabled network optimization. CNML 2027 aims to provide an international forum for researchers and industry professionals to present innovative research, exchange technical knowledge, and foster collaboration in the development of intelligent communication systems and next-generation networking technologies.
